messages.author: Ruala
messages.text: More kitties visiting me. That cat has claimed the maple tree stump as his own. He looks cute on it, so he's welcome to lounge.

messages.author: Ruala
messages.text: Also yes I live in a white trashy neighborhood lol

messages.author: Ruala
messages.text: That house across the street is poorly designed. No one with money would live there

messages.author: Selene and the cats
messages.text: You have cats visiting you so it ain't all bad.

messages.author: Ruala
messages.text: Me too, especially this one. He's my neighbor's cat, but apparently he trusts me if he's willing to show me that much of a stretch lol

messages.author: Selene and the cats
messages.text: Cats are just the best. Period.

messages.author: Ruala
messages.text: I've had a phase when spending time and taking care of my cat was my reason to get out of bed. So yeah, cats are essential .
